Summary: God's providence is His wise and loving governance of all things, by which He sustains creation and directs history toward His purposes. It means that nothing is random to God — not the fall of a sparrow, not the rise of empires, not the details of our lives — yet without making God the author of evil. Providence is a doctrine of comfort: the world is not in chaos, but in the hands of a Father.
